author: National Geographic
description:
Utilizing rare archival footage and personal recordings, Diana: In Her Own Words: A Lasting Legacy documents the life of Princess Diana and her marriage to Charles, the future king. From the doomed marriage, their two sons Prince William and Prince Harry are born, becoming Diana’s lasting legacy following her tragic death that shook the world and changed the British monarchy forever.
